Monitor treatment progress and assist with continuity of care.
Communicate regularly with providers regarding records, treatment updates, and billing information.
Identify potential issues that could impact case progression.

Case Management

Collect and review medical records, billing documentation, and supporting evidence.
Assist in preparing demand packages and settlement documentation.
Track case milestones and proactively move cases toward resolution.

Communicate with insurance adjusters and medical providers.

Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
Ability to manage a high-volume caseload while maintaining attention to detail.
Proficiency with case management software and Microsoft Office.

Experience working in a Plaintiff Personal Injury law firm.
Experience with Filevine, SmartAdvocate, CasePeer, Litify, or similar platforms.

Experience handling pre-litigation cases.

Compassionate and client-focused

Strong communicators
Proactive problem-solvers
Adaptable in a fast-paced environment
Team-oriented professionals
Committed to delivering exceptional client service

Career advancement pathways

FLF is a growing Personal Injury Law Firm dedicated to helping injured individuals and their families obtain the justice and compensation they deserve.

Communicate and coordinate with patients’ physicians to ensure a quality level of care.

Current unrestricted CA Physical Therapist License

As an Environmental Review Coordinator with the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources, you will be a part of our fast-moving effort to protect plants, wildlife and habitats across Pennsylvania. Your work will help guide conservation through tools such as the PA Conservation Explorer tool and ensure thoughtful review of major projects. Join a dedicated team that is energized by protecting natural resources and improving the world around us.
